name: REACHTEN
recent: Reach Ten Holdings Berhad 近期持续进行股份回购，并有多项董事及大股东持股变动的申报。公司2026年第二季度净利因SpaceX公允价值收益而近乎翻倍。此外，公司呼吁砂拉越州政府提供资金以改善偏远地区连接。
notable: 公司持续进行股份回购。
董事 Chin Yu Lay 在公开市场增持股份。
2026年第二季度净利润因SpaceX投资公允价值收益而近乎翻倍。
risks: 董事 Chin Yu Lay 在闭门期前表示有意进行交易。
earnings: 2026年第二季度营收为2737.5万令吉，环比增长12.6%，同比增长2.2%；净利润为1857.3万令吉，环比增长126.0%，同比增长97.1%；净利率为67.8%，高于上一季度的33.8%。

recent_en: The company's 2Q 2026 net profit nearly doubled due to a SpaceX fair value gain. Additionally, the company called for Sarawak state funding to improve rural connectivity.
notable_en: Director Chin Yu Lay acquired shares in the open market.
2Q 2026 net profit nearly doubled due to a fair value gain on SpaceX investment.
risks_en: Director Chin Yu Lay indicated intention to deal during the closed period.
earnings_en: 2Q 2026 revenue was MYR 27.375 million, up 12.6% QoQ and 2.2% YoY; net income was MYR 18.573 million, up 126.0% QoQ and 97.1% YoY; net margin was 67.8%, higher than 33.8% in the previous quarter.
